title: Isithunzi Esingemuva Kwesihlalo Sobukhosi
intro: Umi ngaphakathi kwezinkantolo zombuso wasendulo onamandla, lapho umbusi onamandla ezimemezele khona njengonkulunkulu phezu kwabo bonke abantu. Eceleni kwalo mbusi kumi inceku ezinikele, ephathiswe izifiso ezinkulu zombuso. Ndawonye, ​​baceba futhi bahlela, benqaba ukulalela izixwayiso zesithunywa esithunyelwe ukubaqondisa. Ungayithola yini ukuthi yayingubani le nceku ethembekile?
clues: Ngangihlala embusweni onamandla obuswa ngumuntu onamandla owayethi unguNkulunkulu phezu kwabo bonke abantu.
Ngangiyisikhonzi esithembekile salo mbusi, ngifeza yonke izifiso zakhe kanye nomyalo wakhe.
Lapho isithunywa sika-Allah sifika ezweni lakithi sisibizela eqinisweni, mina nombusi wami senqaba ukulalela.
Ngayalwa ukuba ngivuthe umlilo omkhulu futhi ngilungise izitini zobumba ukuze ngenze umsebenzi omkhulu.
Umbusi wami wayefuna ukwakha isakhiwo eside kangangokuthi sizofinyelela ezulwini uqobo.
Ekugcineni, umbusi wami, amabutho ethu, kanye nami sakhukhulwa futhi sacwila ekujuleni kolwandle.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
